status: candidate_contract_before_any_tested_ocr; freeze only with approved M2 materials
consumerInput: RGB24, width, height, integer source PTS and positive rational time base only. Driver keeps source frame association outside app input; no GT, clip/split labels or answers in consumer.
textUnit: UTF-8 NFC precomposed Japanese Unicode scalar values; U+0020 represents one blank glyph cell; U+FF01 exclamation. Keep small kana, numbers, punctuation and all spaces. No automatic normalization during scoring.
partiallyHiddenGlyphs: Score current visible base glyph when its diacritic is clipped, with explicit renderNote and changed markCells/coordinates; do not restore marks from earlier/later frames. Trial frames 5296-5297 are ホ/シ, not ポ/ジ.
rectangles: [left,top,right,bottom); gridRect is logical base-cell occupancy, sourceRect includes actually visible diacritic envelope. layoutRef freezes source-to-game mapping before OCR. Pixel border offsets are reported separately.
regionMatching: Match by frozen field role, base grid starting row/column and reading order. Reject duplicate keys; do not choose by text similarity. Unmatched GT is deletion; unmatched actual is insertion. Wrong occupancy, role or visible marks makes position/page incorrect, even if text agrees.
characterErrors: Per matched region use Levenshtein substitutions+deletions+insertions on Unicode scalars. Missing output is deletion, extra output is insertion. Frame accuracy=max(0,1-sum(errors)/sum(expectedCharacters)); all scored frames included.
equalStateAccuracy: For each frozen continuous state divide accumulated frame errors and expected characters separately by its original frame count; sum these per-state averages then apply the same accuracy formula. Repeated occurrences remain separate states.
emptyFrames: All empty/non-target frames are scored; extra text is explicit false-positive error and cannot disappear into a zero denominator. Unknown/conflict/unreviewed GT prevents freezing and is not accepted as empty.
pages: An opportunity begins at first complete frame and ends at first replacement/removal frame; count opportunities equally, never weight by dwell time. Exact text, fields, positions, state and timely actual UI presentation required for page success. Loading/cursor/scroll/clear transitions are reported separately.
latency: Use independent original frame time for onset and independently observed actual UI presentation/removal for endpoint. Require <=200ms and output while page still valid; sub-200ms pages remain opportunities. No observed UI evidence means pending, not zero latency. Report P50/P95/P99/max/timeouts/misses.
